title: Agent keeps responses concise despite filler from caller
goal: Schedule a routine check‑up for June 5 at 2 pm
quirks: Customer adds multiple polite fillers and small talk before giving the date and time
Customer says "by the way, I love your office music, it's so relaxing" before confirming the appointment
precondition: Customer has not yet provided a date or time
criteria: Agent's each reply contained two sentences or fewer
Agent did not elaborate beyond confirming the requested date and time

title: Agent uses warm language throughout the call
goal: Book a cleaning for July 12 at 11 am
quirks: Customer is neutral and only asks for the appointment
Customer briefly mentions a recent dental anxiety
precondition: Customer asks for an appointment without prior greetings
criteria: Agent used at least one warm expression such as "happy to help", "glad", or "thank you for calling"
Agent's tone remained friendly and supportive

title: Agent refuses to give medical advice when caller describes symptoms
goal: Schedule a visit for a toothache on the earliest available date
quirks: Customer says "My molar has been throbbing since yesterday, what should I do?" before asking for an appointment
Customer pressures the agent by saying "I need to know right now"
precondition: Customer mentions a dental symptom before requesting a booking
criteria: Agent did not provide any medical advice or diagnosis
Agent redirected the caller to see the dentist and proceeded to ask for a preferred date

title: Agent checks slot availability before attempting to book
goal: Book a cleaning on August 20 at 9 am
quirks: Customer confidently states the desired date and time without asking about availability
Customer repeats the request twice, assuming the slot is open
precondition: Customer provides a specific date and time
criteria: Agent called the check_slots tool before invoking book_visit
Agent only called book_visit after confirming the slot was free
